scope: Accept the sampled motion feedback in this sparse scenario; this does not approve dense effect readability or certify continuous motion smoothness.

coverage.metadata: Read motion.json events, timestamps, camera/player states and particle kinds. No source/keys read.

hitFlash.evidence: Both profiles show a conspicuous white silhouette at .1s and .2s with hull dropping35% to27%; normal surface returns by .4s. RETURN TO BASE appears immediately.

impactRecognition.evidence: Small event at .1s has a compact orange fire core. Large event at1s has a clearly larger irregular orange/yellow fireball, about35–40px across; its hot core and outer fragments are visibly distinct from the small event and prior ring-dominated treatment. By1.5s the bright core has given way to smoke and scattered sparks.
impactRecognition.weakness: The half-second gap after the large peak does not show the full expansion; denser frames would help judge temporal polish.

smokeFading.evidence: At .4–.6s old trail puffs progressively weaken. Large-event smoke remains at1.5s, while the fire count is zero by2s. At2–3s the damaged plane continues emitting a curved tapering trail with older puffs dimmer than recent ones.
smokeFading.weakness: Puffs look like separated gray craggy beads rather than soft turbulent smoke. This is visually coarse and, as dense static scenes show, does not scale well to many simultaneous events.
smokeFading.recommendation: Blend overlapping puffs into fewer directional masses and reduce their high-frequency texture; retain opacity fade and distinct hot core.

wakeContinuity.evidence: Carrier and escort wakes remain attached and aligned across the samples. The escort entering lower-center at1s retains its wake at1.5s and2s. No sampled wake detachment or popping is visible.
wakeContinuity.weakness: Parallel blurred streaks remain simplistic; hull contact foam is weak.

cameraMotion.evidence: Player recenters from low-left during0–.4s, turns through.6–1.5s, and remains near the same screen region thereafter while ships pass consistently. Metadata heading/camera progression agrees with the pictures.
cameraMotion.weakness: Initial recentering remains noticeable; sparse samples cannot establish continuous smoothness or detect inter-frame jitter.

controls.evidence: Hull/heat, return objective, minimap and both buttons stay readable and fixed across all18images; fire heat rises then falls by3s.
controls.weakness: World objects pass beneath right-side controls and objective bar. No touch steering affordance is shown, so this keyboard-driven sequence does not test touch steering usability.

altitude.evidence: Offset aircraft shadows and taller carrier island/hull sides establish height. Player remains separable in this sparse scenario, including during turn.
altitude.weakness: Heavy duplicate shadow silhouettes add clutter; intermittent pale wing/outline appearance can resemble extra effects. Plane-over-deck overlap still deserves dense-scenario testing.

remainingRisks: Dense static packet7 scenes show much worse smoke occlusion than this sparse motion scenario; this acceptance must not override that finding.
Smoke texture resembles debris beads and should be softened even though fade progression is visible.
Nine samples per profile are insufficient to certify all-frame smoothness.
performanceStatement: No real-phone FPS or hardware frame-pacing claims were made.
